caseTitle: Pink Panthers — synthetic demo (NOT real data)
caseHypothesis: A car-rental fixer in Belgrade (Dragan Kovac) is the logistical bridge between six otherwise-isolated smash-and-grab cells. Each hit is preceded ~40h by a burst of prepaid-SIM activations in the target city. "Ivan Petrov" and "John Smith" are one operative on a forged passport.

entities.name: Dragan Kovac (Belgrade car-rental)
entities.notes: Never robs. Rents the getaway cars for every cell.
